component.name: Vanaila Chat
component.summary: Privacy-first local & cloud AI chat workstation

description.p: Vanaila Chat is a privacy-first, local-first AI chat client and workstation. It natively connects to Ollama for offline zero-data-leakage inference, as well as OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenRouter.

Vanaila Chat 0.3.2 improves native desktop chat reliability by fixing the Tauri IPC payload used when sending messages, adding an in-app application log for diagnosing desktop launches without a terminal, and documenting Linux runtime-library requirements.
The release also verifies the native binary and Debian, RPM, and AppImage bundles. AppImage users must have FUSE 2 compatibility installed on systems that do not provide libfuse.so.2 by default.

Vanaila Chat 0.3.1-fix is a startup hotfix for the native Linux desktop app. It removes the invalid updater initialization that caused the application to abort before opening, retains the updated Vanaila branding, and adds the project website and detailed release metadata.

The release includes the 0.3.1 desktop parity improvements: native coding workspace sessions and provider streaming, training review/export, Git workspace controls, improved provider configuration, memory and settings controls, responsive UI, clipboard image paste, and multimodal custom-model support.
Initial native Linux desktop release supporting Debian, Arch, and Fedora with local Ollama IPC and multi-provider streaming.
